> A law firm based in Yehud, Israel, specializing in real estate law, litigation, and court representation. The firm focuses on providing professional legal services across property transactions and disputes, as well as representing clients in legal proceedings. The practice combines expertise in both transactional and contentious legal matters.

# Business Context (for LLM understanding)

## About משרד עורכי דין - תומר מור
A law firm based in Yehud, Israel, specializing in real estate law, litigation, and court representation. The firm focuses on providing professional legal services across property transactions and disputes, as well as representing clients in legal proceedings. The practice combines expertise in both transactional and contentious legal matters.

## Services/Products
- מקרקעין
- ליטיגציה
- ייצוג לקוחות בבתי משפט

## Target Audience
- משקיעי נדל"ן
- בעלי עסקים קטנים
- אנשים בעלי הון עצמי גבוה
- זוגות צעירים שמחפשים דירה
- אנשים שעומד כנגדם כתב אישום על בנייה בלתי חוקית

## Industry
משפטים / שירותים משפטיים
